chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The muhrim, if he fears, may wear weapons.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim wear weapons while in the state of ihram if he fears danger?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah. It states that a muhrim is permitted to wear weapons when there is fear, showing an allowance based on need and safety.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2622 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"If a Muhrim fears for his safety, he may wear weapons."
